claims.evidence: The witness confirmed a PS5 console and one matching wireless controller.
The witness report does not mention a game disc.
Photo 1 shows visible scratches and scuffs on the glossy black center section.
Requires physical inspection of the warranty seals which are not described.
Requires running a demanding game for an extended period.
Requires testing each port with a cable.
The witness only saw one controller; the seller implies multiple ('pads').
The witness did not report seeing a receipt.

risks.risk: The console may not output video or boot to the dashboard.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the console booting from a cold start to the home menu.

risks.risk: The disc drive may be unable to read or eject discs.
risks.proof: A video showing a disc being inserted, recognized by the UI, and then ejected.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A clip of the controller being used to navigate menus or a controller test app.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Video of the FIFA disc being inserted and the game icon appearing.
Photo of the UK receipt mentioned by the seller.
Photo of any additional controllers ('pads') claimed.
Screenshot of the 'Storage' settings to confirm internal capacity.
response.reason: The item is identified as a PlayStation 5 Disc Edition, but due to visible cosmetic damage and lack of functional proof, it must be priced as a non-working unit.
